# graylog_extractor (Data Source)

Retrieves an extractor by input and extractor IDs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "graylog_extractor" "example" {
  input_id = "input-id"
  id       = "extractor-id"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `input_id` (String)

### Read-Only

- `extractor_type` (String)
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `payload_json` (String)
- `title` (String)
